subject: Mutual action plan and signature window — Centaura pilot (MSA / DPA / order form dependencies)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@centaura.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual action plan and signature window — Centaura pilot (MSA / DPA / order form dependencies)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I pulled together a compact closure checklist that stacks the evaluation milestones with the legal/procurement gates so we can see the critical path (MSA + DPA + order form). I attached a one-sheet workbook (Centaura_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out week-by-week owner assignments, required evidence, and the minimal signature window to hit a Dec 15 pilot start.

Key notes up front:
- MSA redlines: there are 3 high-priority comments from your legal team that affect data residency and subprocessor flow — these need a short-cycle review from both sides.
- DPA: Centaura will need SOC2 + retention clause alignment before we put production tokens into the pilot. We can run the pilot under a limited data-scope addendum if necessary, but that adds an extra doc.
- Order form: billing and PO number are the final step; finance needs the exact product SKUs and a signed MSA reference to issue a PO.

Request: Please confirm the internal approvers and any blackout dates for procurement reviews over the next four weeks. If we can get legal feedback on the three redlines by end-of-week (Fri 11/20), I can loop in Karthik and Laura to finalize an order form and push a DocuSign packet the following week.

Next steps I propose:
1) Emily / Procurement to send who-on-legal + procurement approver (by 11/19 EOD)
2) Our legal (Karthik) to provide a short comment matrix on the 3 MSA items (by 11/23)
3) Get DPA evidence (SOC2 link + retention confirmation) — Emily to share (by 11/24)
4) Finalize order form and run DocuSign: target sending 11/30 for 12/15 pilot start

Attachments: Centaura_MAP_v1.xlsx, OrderForm-draft.xlsx (stubs)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick alignment call if helpful.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

From: Emily Santos <emily.santos@centaura.com>

Date: 2026-11-18T13:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and signature window — Centaura pilot (MSA / DPA / order form dependencies)

Jordan —

Appreciate the one-sheet. Quick answers:
- Legal approver is me (I own the procurement review) and our outside counsel will weigh in on data residency; I added procurement@centaura.com to keep the team looped.
- We can try to get the initial redline notes to you by Friday (11/20) but our counsel has a heavy docket this week; if needed we can push to early next week.
- SOC2: we have a hosted SOC2 report, I will share a link to the summary (no full extracts) — can you confirm whether that will satisfy your DPA acceptance or if you need exact control mappings?

Two asks from my side:
1) Can Redwood provide a fallback plan if the MSA negotiation takes longer than you expect? For example, a limited pilot addendum that reduces data scope so we can proceed while legal finishes redlines.
2) Can you confirm whether billing details (PO vs invoice) change for pilots vs production? Our finance prefers PO issuance — we want to avoid manual invoices if possible.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Santos
Sr. Program Lead, Data Platform | Centaura Health
emily.santos@centaura.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Santos <emily.santos@centaura.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and signature window — Centaura pilot (MSA / DPA / order form dependencies)

Thanks, Emily — copying Karthik (legal) and Laura (sales ops) to confirm the two asks.

On your questions:
- Fallback pilot addendum: yes — we routinely do a limited-scope pilot addendum that narrows retention and prohibits export of PHI-level samples. That addendum is a short form (1–2 pages) and has been accepted for several pilots; I attached a draft order form and will ask Karthik to confirm language.
- Billing: Finance prefers a PO for pilots as well; we are happy to accept a PO reference on the order form. If Centaura needs invoice-based billing temporarily we can support net-30 invoices but that will require a billing contact and PO fallback note in the order form.

Karthik — short ask: can you review the three flagged MSA clauses (data residency, subprocessors, backup access) and propose either accept-as-is language or a minimal alternate that keeps us within our standard security posture but doesn't block the PO. I can put together a comment matrix once we have your guidance.

Laura — can you confirm the DocuSign cadence? I propose sending the combined MSA + addendum + order form as a single envelope once redlines are reconciled (or else send the addendum + order form if MSA takes longer).

Thanks — Jordan

-------------------------------------------

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emily Santos <emily.santos@centaura.com>, Procurement <procurement@centaura.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan and signature window — Centaura pilot (MSA / DPA / order form dependencies)

Jordan / Emily / team —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the three clauses and propose the following minimal path to keep the schedule intact:

1) Data residency: Counter-proposal — add a narrow residency commitment for customer production data only; pilot data may be stored in our multi-region staging environment with the restriction that it not be used for model training. That keeps the pilot operational while protecting Centaura's production data.

2) Subprocessors: Add a required subprocessors notice period of 10 business days and a right-to-object with escalation to both legal teams. We will share our current subprocessors list and commit to provide any future additions with that notice.

3) Backup access / recovery: Replace the broad recovery language with an incident-led access clause that requires a joint approval path and an attestation that data used during recovery will be deleted after testing.

If Centaura agrees to the above, I recommend we:
- Exchange a short comment matrix (Karthik / Jordan -> Emily) by 11/23;
- Prepare a pilot addendum (Redwood) and updated order form (Laura) by 11/25;
- Emily to confirm SOC2 link and finance contact by 11/24;
- Target DocuSign envelope send on 11/30 with PO reference.

Fallback / contingency: If legal cannot clear the three items by 11/30, we will proceed with a signed pilot addendum + order form that omits MSA signature for the pilot and places the full MSA execution on a 30-day contingency window; billing will be via PO and pilot activation scoped to non-production tokens only.

DocuSign link (provisional): https://www.docusign.com/efd/rdw-centaura-msa
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/78641

Action owners:
- Karthik: comment matrix & proposed clause text (due 11/23)
- Emily / Procurement: SOC2 link + legal approver contact + finance PO owner (due 11/24)
- Laura: order form draft and DocuSign envelope prep (due 11/25)
- Jordan: coordinate and confirm send cadence (target 11/30)

I'll draft the formal comment matrix and circulate A.S.A.P.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
